text:
Euclase: http://euclase.ai - the creative harness for generative AI

Unifying all the various image/video gen (comfyui for local, api for closed) in one cohesive desktop app, with integrated agents to pilot the whole thing (if you want). It's been fun to build and quite fun to use. Technically out in beta and testable, but working on refining onboarding/docs before I try going wider.

Finding a balance between deep enough to satisfy more technical creatives (like me) and less technical ones. Agent integration helps tremendously with the latter.
